# Shoot 360 Denver

> Shoot 360 Denver is a technology-based basketball training facility inside FieldhouseUSA at 14200 E Alameda Ave, Aurora, CO 80012, in the Denver metro area. It offers shooting and skills training with real-time shot feedback and coaching for players of all ages and skill levels, from youth learning fundamentals to high-school, college and adult athletes.

Prices, hours and schedules can change. The site pages and the Shoot 360 app are the source of truth.

## Key facts

- Location: inside FieldhouseUSA, 14200 E Alameda Ave, Aurora, CO 80012. Park in the FieldhouseUSA lot and use the main entrance.
- Hours: Monday to Friday 2:00 to 9:00 PM, Saturday and Sunday 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Hours shift around camps, leagues and events.
- Contact: 720-773-0050, admin@shoot360denver.com. Instagram: @shoot360denver.
- Technology: the Splash Meter gives instant feedback on arc, depth and left-right alignment for every shot. Skill courts measure passing and ball-handling. Workouts are tracked in the Shoot 360 app.
- A session is one hour: 30 minutes on a shooting bay (300 or more measured shots) and 30 minutes on a skills court.
- Getting started: first-time visitors book an evaluation session. It is coach-led, takes about an hour, and carries no obligation to join. A parent or guardian attends with minors.
- Memberships (monthly, prices as listed on the site as of Sept 19, 2026): JV $159 for 4 sessions, Varsity $199 for 8 sessions, Committed $239 unlimited, Ball is Life $230 unlimited on a 12-month commitment. Coaching during sessions is included in every membership. There is a one-time $40 enrollment fee, and sales tax is not included.
- Drop-in session without a membership: $72. Members add an extra session for $40.
- Unlimited Classes and Little Ballers (ages 6 to 10): $149 per month.
- Programs: coach-led classes, school-break camps, Nike Basketball Camps, leagues, club basketball through Team EVO, and private training.
- Registration for classes, camps, leagues and drop-in sessions is done in the Shoot 360 app.
- Events: birthday parties, corporate and team events, and date nights. Two courts for two hours is $160.
